math.tagline: Mgbakọ na mwepụ na-enyere ndụ gị aka
math.description: Site n'ọkwa mbụ ruo nke elu, mara echiche mgbakọ na mwepụ bara uru na idozi nsogbu ndụ n'ezie site n'mkpa na-atọ ụtọ.

english.description: Karịa nkwadebe ule—mụọ Bekee bara uru maka mkparịta ụka kwa ụbọchị, ịrị elu n'ọrụ, azụmahịa, na njem ụwa site n'obere mkpa.

korean.description: Site n'mkpụrụedemede Hangul ruo Korea azụmahịa, mepee ohere na njikọ ọhụrụ site n'ihe ọmụmụ akọwara n'asụsụ obodo gị.

life.tagline: Ozi ndụ na-enyere ndụ gị aka
life.description: Ozi ndụ na-enyere ndụ gị aka

physics.description: Ihe omume sayensị fiziks iji ghọta ụkpụrụ nke igwe, ọkụ eletrik na ike.

chemistry.description: Ihe omume kemistri iji ghọta nhazi nke ihe, mmeghachi omume na kemistri na ndụ kwa ụbọchị.
